title: CV

Work experience







2025-present
Post-doctoral researcher at Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1
Epidemiology and modelling of viral respiratory infections at the Hospices Civils de Lyon


2020-2025
Post-doctoral researcher at Institut Paster/Université de Versailles Saint Quentin

2019-2020

Mathematical modelling of national malaria incidence and intervention scenarios in Benin and Cameroon

Senior technical adviser at Clinton Health Access Initiative

2016-2017

Epidemiological support and planning for Bukavu mission, Democratic Republic of the Congo

Research associate at Imperial College London
Vaccine epidemiology relating to poliovirus elimination efforts in Afghanistan, Pakistan and Nigeria


2012-2014
Post-doctoral researcher at ETH Zürich
Modelling and phylogenomics of HIV drug resistance
